scope: v0.26.5 RC1 attempt 24 supersedes attempt 23 after user testing proved model discovery works (36 detected) but the 3D card visuals themselves could remain blank. Settings > Customization remains the only location for Platform visuals: Icons or 3D Models, Icon card size, 3D model size, and 3D Models Folder, with PlatformVisualStyle and both scales persisted across restarts. User-owned GLBs remain in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Huymaier Console\3D Models (or the optional portable 3D Models folder) using the exact original 36 filenames; normal release bytes contain zero bundled GLBs. Games platform cards now use an icon-first lazy architecture: the proven original icon card is rendered immediately, matching user models are queued after the Games rail exists, and each icon is replaced only after a valid live WPF Viewport3D has been constructed. Any failed model keeps/restores its icon, so 3D mode can never produce an empty visual merely because a GLB fails. Card-mode rendering uses the original GLB positions, normals, triangle indices, node hierarchy/matrix/TRS transforms and base material colors while deliberately skipping expensive embedded texture decoding; meshes remain genuine live 3D geometry, are double-sided for mixed source winding conventions, and are normalized/fitted to the card camera. The X/Square full-screen viewer still uses the original full material/texture GLB loader and supports rotation/zoom. The final user layer bypasses the retired static-preview/atlas rail wrapper and resolves aliases directly to the original supplied filenames. New Windows source and staged-package visual gates instantiate the actual x64 HuymaierLiveModel3D.dll, arrange card/full LiveModelView controls, render them through WPF RenderTargetBitmap, and fail unless the model produces real non-transparent pixels; the validated source rendered 6864 card pixels, 8468 after rotation, and 6864 full-viewer pixels. Browser cursor ownership remains native-only with HuymaierUnifiedCursor V2 loaded last and the old hc-virtual-cursor transform retired. Preserve all previously proven GameCube, Downloads, Performance, native streaming, Sony Raw-HID, Game Bar, Wii/Dolphin, provider concurrency, installer rollback/tamper, Steam/Nintendo ownership, and frozen PS1/PS2/PS3 behavior. Upload only if source and staged-package visible-pixel, lazy-card, icon-fallback, user-folder/no-bundled-GLB, native-cursor, installer and every inherited release gate succeed together.
